description: Queue bulk machine translation jobs (published default-language originals only; manual translations stay). Same arguments as lang_mt_estimate; run the estimate first, it shows the characters that will be billed. Needs the site entitled (refused with cvrt_lang_read_only otherwise).

ids.description: Source post ids (1 to 50); only with scope object

lang.description: Target language code (active, not the default); omitted means every active non-default language

post_type.description: Limit to one post type in Lang mode translate

scope.description: What to translate: object (the post ids given), missing (no translation yet), outdated (source changed), all. Server default: all

unit_keys.description: Only these unit keys; needs scope object, exactly one id and a lang

name: lang_mt_enqueue
